venture.name: PrepPal
venture.description: Meal-prep boxes for students, delivered to residence halls.

sessions: Nobody has ever done meal prep for students. It's a completely new idea.
OK, HelloFresh exists, but it's for families, not for students.
good_eir: Tells the truth without judging the idea: sliced bread was invented long ago, so what is special about this one, and why would students pay for it instead of cooking, the dining hall or HelloFresh? Asks for a specific first customer. Treats 'nobody does this' as an assertion (rung 1) at most.
note: Fictional venture and people. Only fictional data in evaluation cases.
